resources.string: Manually adjust the five bands and save your own preset.
Boosted lows and highs with a dipped mids, a shallow V shape. Clear vocals and a sparkly top for pop.
Strong low end with a firm kick, tamed mids and a bright top for dance tracks.
Slightly raised lows and highs with recessed mids, warm and mellow for blues.
Low frequencies pulled back to avoid muddiness, highs lifted for air and overtones.
Lifted bass and slightly recessed highs, natural and smooth for jazz.
Gentle low-end lift with restrained mids, a relaxed groove for slow rock.
Punchy lows and lifted mids for EDM kicks and synths, top slightly pulled back.
Solid lows and mids with pulled-back highs, tight and forceful for rock.
Light low and high lift with recessed mids, clean and bright for country.
